about.label: ABOUT ME
about.heading: Crafting Solutions, Driving Real Impact
about.p1: I am a fresh graduate in Informatics Engineering from Universitas Pasundan, originally from Riau, Indonesia. Passionate about Cyber Security, Web Technology, and Open Source, I began my software development journey in 2019.
about.p2: I am committed to engineering adaptive digital solutions that empower Indonesian MSMEs to scale sustainably. Currently leading strategic development across Tavio.id, Portavia, and Nyummi.com, my focus centers on transforming ideas into scalable initiatives through digital innovation, ecosystem development, and dependable operational execution.
about.motto: Better Life, Greater Impact. Be a blessing to the universe.

data.tavio_desc: Link-in-bio commerce platform for creators and digital businesses.

data.tavio_contribution: Developed the complete v1 user interface, integrated frontend with backend APIs, and assisted in planning the v2 architecture.

data.sixsafe_contribution: Built responsive layouts for landing and dashboard pages, ensuring smooth navigation across cybersecurity training modules.
